messages.author: 6817b1bf67e9ad3f
messages.subject: Log  frequency axis with spectro()
parts:
Hello,

Is it possible to have the frequency axis (y axis) log plotted with spectro() function ?
It would be useful for plotting spectrograms of human voices with F0, F1...Fn usually present in the first kHz...
I couldn't find any argument and log="y" doesn't work.

Thanks.

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Log  frequency axis with spectro()
parts:
Dear Xavier,

You are right this option is not available because I was too lazy to add it...
But this is now in the TODO list and will be included in the next
version of seewave to be released this month (I promess!).

Thanks for your patience,

Best regards,

Jerome
